description: This file defines a Perl module for database schema management using DBIx::Class. It includes schema configuration, connection handling, and database-specific methods for PostgreSQL and SQLite, with custom methods for statistics and foreign key management.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema
classes.description: A schema class extending DBIx::Class::Schema::Config, providing custom connection handling, statistics, and database-specific methods.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Overrides the default connection method to set default foreign key pragma for SQLite and manage connect info.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of records across specified resultsets or all sources.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Provides aggregated statistics for dishes, recipes, projects, users, and organizations.

methods.name: pgsql_set_constraints_deferred
methods.description: Sets PostgreSQL constraints to deferred mode if connected to PostgreSQL.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Temporarily disables foreign key checks in SQLite during execution of a provided code reference.

methods.name: enable_fk_checks
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: disable_fk_checks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets a SQLite PRAGMA value.
